title: Nordics from Mars caused the extinction of the dinosaurs

tellings.quote: So the Nordics coming here from Mars were responsible for the extinction of the dinosaurs.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, drawing on a work called Closer Encounters, describes the "Nordics", tall human-looking beings that appear in UFO stories. He says that Nordics who came to Earth from Mars were responsible for wiping out the dinosaurs. If true, it would mean non-human beings shaped the whole history of life on Earth.
